chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade entering a dark house except with a lantern.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet forbid regarding entering a dark house?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the Prophet’s emphasis on *adab* (etiquette) and practical wisdom in daily conduct. It underscores the principle of avoiding *khafa* (darkness/obscurity) not seeing) to prevent accidental harm or social embarrassment, reflecting the broader Shia focus on integrating spiritual mindfulness with mundane actions.
